description: We've spent the last few years watching AI transform the digital world. Now it's coming for the physical one. Humanoid robots are leaving the lab and entering homes, factories, and workplaces. But are we witnessing another ChatGPT moment, or are these machines still years away from becoming truly useful? Journalist Stephen Witt has spent months inside the world's leading robotics companies to find out, and what he discovered surprised him. Check out Stephen's article "Are Humanoid Robots Ready t…
classificationReason: Entire episode examines humanoid robots, their deployment readiness, and real-world usefulness.
qualityReason: Based on an extended journalist investigation and discussion of leading robotics companies.
